themes.name: nesting under change
themes.hint: resize and move parents while children are inside, reparent in and out, undo across it

themes.name: geometry extremes
themes.hint: tiny and huge rects, negative coordinates, states far apart, children on the border of the parent

themes.name: undo and redo interleaving
themes.hint: undo in the middle of a construction, redo, then edit; undo after a deletion

themes.name: deletion of parents
themes.hint: delete states that hold children and attached transitions, delete a transition source, undo

themes.name: identity changes
themes.hint: rename and update ids of elements that transitions and comments reference, then edit them

themes.name: comments and subjects
themes.hint: comments pointing at elements that are moved, reparented, renamed and deleted

themes.name: transitions everywhere
themes.hint: self transitions, transitions between nesting levels, from and to pseudostates, polylines, then move the ends

themes.name: gestures on a crowded diagram
themes.hint: drag, resize and draw loops on states that overlap or touch, then delete by click

themes.name: build from scratch by gestures
themes.hint: draw a real controller (traffic light, vending machine, robot mission) with the tools only: states by placement, transitions by the tool, texts typed on the canvas; no model verbs

themes.name: refactoring session
themes.hint: extract a composite state, move a group of states into it, redirect the transitions, rename, then undo half of it

themes.name: text-heavy behaviours
themes.hint: actions and labels as real code in C, Python or a pseudolanguage: multi-line entry and exit, long guards, edits of existing texts, empty and whitespace texts

themes.name: student session with mistakes
themes.hint: build a small controller, make typical errors (wrong parent, duplicate name, a transition from a final state), take the refusals, correct, save and reopen

themes.name: sequential growth
themes.hint: start from a single state and extend the system one concern at a time, keeping the diagram clean and non-messy: each round adds a state or a behaviour, children inside their parents, siblings apart, no overlaps
